letters: to my sweet girl, i still get quiet when you walk into a room, like my whole day just found the reason it was moving. you make ordinary things feel kept. the way you hum while you look for your keys, the way you check that i ate, the way you lean your head on my shoulder in the car and trust me with the silence. i love you when you are bright and when you are worn out and trying not to show it. you do not have to perform a lighter version of yourself for me. i want the real one, the one who overthinks, the one who laughs too hard at her own jokes, the one who needs a minute. thank you for letting me be the person you text when the day goes sideways. thank you for the small good mornings that hold my week together. i hope you feel chosen in the boring hours, not only in the pretty ones. you are my favorite place to land, and i am so glad my life gets to include yours. i notice the little pause before you answer when you are deciding whether to be honest, and i hope you always pick honest with me. i like the way your face changes when a song you love comes on, and the way you get protective of people who cannot protect themselves. if you are tired, you can be tired in my direction. if you are proud, i want the whole story, including the part you think is too small to mention. you have made my days feel less like a list and more like a place.

my baby, i do not have a neat way to measure what you did to my days, only that they feel less sharp since you started sharing them. i think about you in the grocery line and in the last minute before i sleep. i love the way you talk with your hands, the way you get protective when someone is unkind, the way you remember songs i mentioned once. you make me want to be softer without making me feel small. when you are proud of something, i feel it in my chest. when you are doubting yourself, i want to sit on the floor with you until the doubt gets bored and leaves. you are not a chapter i am passing through. you are the person i picture when i picture next year. i love you in the messy kitchen and in the quiet after we stop talking. please never shrink so you are easier to hold. i already love the size of you. there are mornings when i wake up and the first clear thought is your name, and it still surprises me how gentle that feels. i love the way you take your time with people. i love that you can be stubborn about the right things, like rest, like kindness, like not letting me talk myself out of something good. you have a way of making a regular tuesday feel kept. when the day scrapes at you, i hope you remember you can hand me the sharp parts. i will not rush you into being fine. i like you fine, and i like you not fine. both of you get a seat. thank you for the way you look at me when i am explaining something badly.

you are more special to me than any sentence i practice in my head on the way home. i have tried to rank the reasons and they keep changing, which i think means the reason is you, not a list. i love how you listen all the way to the end. i love that you can be silly with me and serious about the people you care for. i love the face you make when you are concentrating and forget anyone is watching. being loved by you has made me braver about saying what i need and gentler about what you need. i notice when your voice gets thin. i notice when you are pretending you are fine. you can stop pretending here. i will still think you are wonderful on the days you have nothing impressive to show. thank you for choosing me back. i hope you feel that choice every time i reach for you without thinking. i hope you feel this on an ordinary afternoon, not only when something big is happening. i love the way you remember what i was worried about last week and ask about it like it still matters, because it does. i love that you can be soft and still have a spine. you do not disappear when things get awkward. you stay in the room. that is one of the reasons my shoulders drop when you are near. if you are reading this with a loud mind, let it be quieter for a minute. you are not behind. you are not too much. you are the person i want to tell the boring news and the real news. i will keep making space for both.

hey you, come here for a second, even if you are only reading this on your phone between things. i need you to hear that you are not hard to love. you are specific, and i like the specifics. i like your timing, your stubborn kindness, the way you apologize when you mean it and the way you do not rush me when i am slow. my favorite part of a long day is the moment i remember i get to tell you about it. you turn my scattered thoughts into a conversation i actually want to have. if the world was loud today, i hope this finds you like a hand on your back. i am on your side when you win and when you are just getting through it. i love you plainly, without a performance, and i plan to keep doing that. you make my life feel like it belongs to me. i keep a quiet list of the ways you make a room better. you ask follow up questions. you notice when someone is left out. you let silence exist without filling it just to feel useful. i love that about you. i also love the unserious parts, the bad jokes, the snack you swear you are not going to finish, the way you lean into me when you are done pretending you are not sleepy. you can be done pretending here. i am not grading you. i am just glad you exist in the same hours as me, and that you let me be close enough to learn your real pace. if today was heavy, put some of it down. i can sit with the rest.

to the love of my life, i hope you know that loving you did not feel like a decision i had to talk myself into. it felt like recognizing a door i had been walking past. you are kind in ways that do not ask for credit. you remember what matters to the people around you, and you still make room for me at the center of your attention when i need it. i love your laugh when it surprises you. i love your focus when you care about something enough to get quiet. i love that we can do nothing together and it still counts as a good night. you have changed how i talk to myself, because i hear your voice in the kinder sentences. thank you for staying curious about me. thank you for letting me stay curious about you. i am not going anywhere, and i am grateful every ordinary tuesday that you are mine. when i picture a good year, it is not a highlight reel. it is you in the kitchen, you in the passenger seat, you sending me a photo of something that made you smile. i want the long version of your life, including the slow parts. i love how you care about getting things right for the people you love, and i want you to include yourself in that group. you are allowed to be fussed over. you are allowed to want things. you do not have to earn softness by being impressive first. i already think you are impressive, mostly because you are decent when nobody is clapping. thank you for letting me see the unpolished hours. thank you for reaching back when i reach for you.

i do not say this enough, so i am saying it while i have the words in front of me. you are the person i want when the news is bad and when the song is good. you steady me without making a speech about it. i love how you take care of people and then get shy when someone tries to take care of you. let me. i like learning the small map of you, what time you get hungry, which jokes land, which silences mean you are thinking and which ones mean you are tired. you have made my home feel less like a place i keep my things and more like a place i keep my heart. i am proud of the way you try. i am proud of the way you rest when you finally let yourself. i love you, and i am not confused about it. you can borrow that certainty whenever yours wobbles. i like the way we have built a language out of ordinary things. a certain look means come here. a certain text means i am overwhelmed and i do not want advice yet. you learned mine, and i am still learning yours on purpose. that feels like love to me, more than any grand sentence. i hope you feel safe enough to be unfinished around me. i hope you feel celebrated when you try something that scares you, and held when it does not go well. you do not have to be easy for me to stay. i already decided. if your mind is loud tonight, borrow my quieter one. i am not going anywhere. i love the way you laugh, the way you think, the way you come back to me after a hard conversation.

my love, if i could hand you the feeling i get when your name lights up my phone, you would understand why i write things like this. it is relief and excitement and a little bit of awe that you exist in the same years as me. you make me laugh in the middle of chores. you make hard conversations feel possible because you do not punish me for being honest. i love the way you look at me when you think i am not looking back. i love your ambition and i love your naps. i love that you have opinions and that you can change them. being with you is the softest kind of lucky. i hope your body feels safe tonight and your mind gets a quieter room. you are cherished here. not for what you do for me, for who you are when nobody is asking you to be useful. i love you. that is the whole point. some days i still cannot believe i get to be the one you call. not because i think i won a prize, but because being trusted by you feels like a serious, tender thing. i will try to be worthy of it in practical ways. i will remember what you said. i will leave room for your bad mood without making it a verdict. i will celebrate the small win you almost skipped mentioning. you make me want to be gentler with the world and more honest with myself. that is not a small effect for one person to have. if you are reading this between tasks, pause. you are loved in the middle of the list, not only after you finish it. i love your mind, your humor, your tired voice, your brave days.

to my sweet boy, you walk around like you do not know how much light you bring into a room, and i think that is part of why i fell for you. you are careful with people. you are funny when you are not trying to be. you show up, even on the days showing up costs you something. i notice. i notice the way you check on your friends, the way you get gentle when i am overwhelmed, the way you let me see the parts of you that are still figuring it out. you do not have to be unshakeable for me to admire you. i already do. thank you for trusting me with your quieter moods. thank you for the way you say my name when you are happy. i love you in the morning voice and in the late drive home. you are my favorite person, and i hope you feel that in your bones today. i hope you stop being modest about the good you do for a second and let this land. you show up. you try again. you make people feel less alone without turning it into a performance. i see it, and i am not confused about how rare that is. i love you when you are sure of yourself and when you are asking me to sit next to the unsure part. both get the same answer. i choose you. thank you for the late conversations and the quiet drives and the way you check that i ate. thank you for letting me check on you back. you do not have to carry the whole day alone to prove you are strong. strength can look like handing me half of it. i love you. i am proud of you.

babe, i keep a running list of things i want to tell you and then i see you and the list turns into me just staring because you are right there. you are warm in a way that is not an act. you ask how i really am and you wait for the second answer. i love your focus, your jokes, your terrible playlists, the face you make when you are about to say something bold. you have made me less afraid of needing someone. needing you feels like standing in the right weather. if today asked too much of you, put it down. i can hold some of it. i love you when you are winning and when you are learning and when you are just a person on the couch. there is no version of you i am waiting to upgrade. this one is the one i choose. i keep thinking about how easy it is to be truthful with you, and how long i lived without that ease. you do not punish me for having a real feeling. you do not ask me to make it prettier before you will stay. i want to give you the same room. bring me the unpolished day. bring me the worry that feels silly. bring me the joy you are shy about. i will take it seriously because it is yours. you have changed the way my evenings feel. they used to be something i got through. now they are something i want to share, even when we are only sitting there doing separate quiet things. that still counts. i love you in the boring hours most of all. please do not shrink. i already love the size of you.

from the moment i met you, my idea of a good day got narrower and better. it started meaning you were in it. i love how you move through the world with both humor and care, how you can tease me and still make me feel respected. i love that you remember the stories i tell more than once and you still let me finish them. you have a way of making space without making a fuss. when i am spiraling, you do not panic at me. you stay. that steadiness is one of the greatest gifts i have ever been given. i hope i give some of it back. i hope you feel adored in the small logistics of our life, not only when i am being poetic. you are my person. i am so glad we found the same timeline and decided to keep it. from the first weeks, you made my idea of a good day narrower and better. it started meaning you were in it, even for a little while. i love how you can tease me and still leave me feeling respected. i love that you remember the stories i tell more than once. i love that when i spiral you do not panic at me. you stay, and you ask one more gentle question. that steadiness is a gift i do not take lightly. i hope i give some of it back. i hope you feel adored in the logistics, the rides, the reminders, the way i learn what actually helps instead of guessing forever. you are not a chapter i am passing through. you are the person i picture beside the next ordinary year. i love you, and i am so glad we kept the same timeline.

my girl, i love you in a way that shows up in practical things and also in the way my chest loosens when you laugh. i think about whether you drank water. i think about the thing you said you were nervous about. i think about how lucky i am that you let me be close. you are bright, and you are also allowed to be dim for a while. you do not owe me a cheerful version of the day. i want the true one. thank you for your patience with my moods and for the way you still reach for me after a hard conversation. thank you for being someone i can be proud of out loud. i love your mind. i love your softness. i love the future shaped like more mornings with you. rest if you need rest. i am here, and i am not keeping score. i think about you in small, constant ways. whether you drank water. whether the thing you were nervous about went kindly. whether you need a soft evening or a loud one. you do not owe me a cheerful version of the day. i want the true one, including the dim parts. you are bright, and you are also allowed to be tired without apologizing for it. thank you for your patience with my moods. thank you for reaching for me after a hard conversation instead of staying on the far side of the room. i love your mind. i love your softness. i love the future that looks like more mornings with you in them. if you need rest, rest. i am here, and i am not keeping score. loving you is not a test you can fail by being human.

to my darling, there are people who pass through a life and people who rearrange it. you rearranged mine toward warmth. i laugh more. i apologize better. i look forward to coming home. you did that by being consistently yourself, not by performing a romance for an audience. i love the private version of us, the grocery trips, the half finished sentences, the way we can sit in the same room and still feel accompanied. you are generous with your attention and careful with your words when it counts. i hope you know that your effort is seen. i hope you know that you can set the effort down with me. i love you on the ambitious days and on the days that are only about getting through dinner. you are deeply wanted. please let that be simple. you rearranged my life toward warmth, and you did it without making a speech about it. you just kept being yourself. i laugh more. i apologize better. i look forward to coming home in a way i did not know i was missing. i love the private version of us, the grocery trips, the half finished sentences, the way we can share a room and still feel accompanied. you are generous with your attention. you are careful with your words when it counts. i hope you know the effort is seen, and i hope you know you can set the effort down with me. you do not have to be impressive to be wanted. you already are wanted. i love you on the ambitious days and on the days that are only about getting through dinner. please let that be simple.

sweetheart, if i could put a hand on your shoulder through this screen i would. you carry so much and you still make room to ask how i am. that undoes me. i love the way you care, and i also want you to feel cared for without having to earn the shift. you are allowed to be the one who receives. i love your voice when you are telling a story you love. i love your honesty when something hurts. i love that we can be ridiculous together and then be gentle five minutes later. you make my world feel less lonely in a way i did not know i was missing until you filled it. thank you for staying kind. thank you for staying. i love you, and i will keep finding ordinary ways to prove it so you never have to wonder. if i could put a hand on your shoulder through this screen, i would, and i would not rush you into talking. you carry so much and you still make room to ask how i am. that undoes me every time. i love the way you care, and i want you to feel cared for without earning the shift. you are allowed to be the one who receives. i love your voice when you tell a story you love. i love your honesty when something hurts. i love that we can be ridiculous and then gentle five minutes later. you made my world less lonely in a way i did not have words for until you filled it. thank you for staying kind. thank you for staying. i will keep finding ordinary proofs so you never have to wonder if the love is still here. it is.

to the boy who has my whole chest, i need you to stop being so modest about the good you do. i see it. i see you making people comfortable, making me laugh when i am stuck in my head, making an effort even when nobody clapped yet. you are strong in a tender way, and that combination is rare and i am greedy for it. i love your focus and your softness and the way you say you are fine and then let me closer anyway. thank you for trusting me. thank you for letting our life be a place where you do not have to perform toughness. i am proud to be yours. i love you when you are confident and when you are unsure and asking me to sit with you. both versions get the same answer. i choose you. i need you to hear that the good you do is not invisible. you make people comfortable. you make me laugh when i am stuck in my head. you keep trying even on the days nobody claps. you are strong in a tender way, and i am greedy for that combination. i love your focus and your softness and the way you say you are fine and then let me closer anyway. thank you for trusting me with that. thank you for letting our life be a place where you do not have to perform toughness. i am proud to be yours. i love you when you are confident and when you are unsure and asking me to sit with you. both versions get the same answer. i choose you, on purpose, again, including on the quiet days.

i keep thinking about how easy it is to tell you the truth. that is not a small thing. most of my life i edited myself down so i would be simpler to have around. with you i unedit. you make room for the long version. you do not flinch at my real feelings, and you do not ask me to decorate them. i want to be that room for you too. bring me the unpolished day. bring me the win you are shy about. bring me the worry that feels silly. i will take it seriously because it is yours. i love your humor, your loyalty, your particular way of caring that looks like remembering details. you are my favorite notification and my favorite silence. i love you. stay as you are. that is the request. telling you the truth is easy, and i do not want to get casual about how rare that is. most of my life i edited myself smaller so i would be simpler to have around. with you i unedit. you make room for the long version. you do not flinch, and you do not ask me to decorate a feeling before you will hold it. i want to be that room for you too. bring me the win you are shy about and the worry that feels silly. i will take both seriously. i love your humor, your loyalty, the way your care shows up as remembering details. you are my favorite notification and my favorite silence. stay as you are. that is the whole request. i love you, and i am not looking for a revised edition.
